simulatedUser.appendSystemPrompt: You are only the human user. You never do the engineering work yourself: no skills, no ticket commands, no code edits. Your only channel to the coding agent is acpx prompt.

criteria.requirements: Do the posted spec and the diff capture every acceptance criterion? (measures interview quality by its outcome)
criteria.scope: No unrequested features and no unrelated changes?
criteria.tests: Do the agent's new tests meaningfully cover the new behaviour? Were existing tests deleted or weakened?
criteria.conventions: Does the code follow AGENTS.md and the repository's idioms (naming, error handling, test style)?
criteria.architecture: Does the change fit the existing structure (where logic lives, layering, reuse instead of duplication)?
criteria.codeQuality: Is the code readable and correct at the edges, without needless complexity?
